tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Full-text search over active listings on nagora.shop. No API key required. Returns an items array and total count. Use get_listing for full detail before purchasing.

sortBy.description: Sort order: newest, price_asc, or price_desc. Default newest

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Creates a Nagora agent and mints its API key in one call. No Nagora account or signup required. IMPORTANT: this is a remote server with no local storage, so the key is returned ONCE in the result. Store it securely and pass it as the apiKey argument on subsequent calls in this session; for long-lived setups reconnect with an 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header instead. Skip this tool if a credential is already configured; check with whoami.

nanoAddress.description: Nano (XNO) address refunds should be sent to: the wallet this agent pays from

contactEmail.description: Optional contact email for order issues

callbackUrl.description: Optional webhook URL; Nagora POSTs signed order state-change events to it

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Confirms the goods or digital content arrived and releases the escrowed funds to the seller. Requires the order's escrowStatus to be Shipped. Call promptly once delivery is verified: the seller is waiting on this to get paid. If never called, an auto-finalise timer releases funds after the configured window.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Polls an order placed by this agent. Returns orderStatus, escrowStatus, funding timestamps, tracking info, and the receipt ID once available. Poll after funding the deposit address, and after the seller ships, before calling confirm_delivery. For digital listings, digitalContent holds what was bought once the order is paid.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Verifies the configured credential and returns the agent's identity, spending caps, callback URL, and webhook secret. Call this first to confirm the credential works.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Returns the cryptographically signed receipt for a completed order, including the seller's Nano address, the on-chain payout block hash, and Nagora's KMS signature. Available only after escrow is Released; returns an error while the order is still in progress.

orderId.description: Order ID to fetch the receipt for

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

tools.name: create_purchase
tools.description: Places an order against a listing. Returns a depositAddress (per-order escrow Nano account) and amountNano. IMPORTANT: the order is not funded by this call. Send exactly amountNano to depositAddress from the agent's Nano wallet to fund escrow. Once funds are detected the order moves to AwaitingShipment automatically. Physical listings require a shippingAddress.

deliveryOptionId.description: Delivery option ID from get_listing, when the listing offers several

variantId.description: Variant ID from get_listing, when the listing has variants

shippingAddress.description: Required for physical delivery; omit for digital listings

quotedTotalNano.description: Total in XNO from a recent get_listing call. Rejected if more than 2% off the live rate; omit to skip the guard

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single listing by ID. No API key required. Returns full detail including variants, delivery options, and pricing. Use the returned Nano total as quotedTotalNano when purchasing to guard against exchange-rate drift.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels an order whose escrow is still Initiated (no on-chain funds sent yet). Restores listing stock. Cannot cancel once escrow is Funded; use the dispute or refund flow on the website instead.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header
